ideas.title: Investigating Fraud in Child Care Programs
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent federal funding freeze block to Minnesota child care programs and potential fraud in the program.
questions: What is the extent of the fraud in the child care program?
How much money is at stake?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant fraud and waste in the child care program. By analyzing public records and following the money, we may be able to identify patterns of abuse and neglect.
